name: @leclabs/agent-cli
//: The INSTALLABLE UNIT — the one package a consumer installs globally. It DECLARES its capability packages as real dependencies, so `npm i -g` resolves them under an isolated store. agent-runtime stays the contract leaf and must NOT depend on a capability (that would cycle: every capability depends on the runtime).
description: @leclabs/agent-cli — the single entry point: the runtime dispatcher plus its declared capability plugins. Bin name is a placeholder pending the brand derivation.
